2. The accused/applicant seeks anticipatory bail in case FIR No.273/2023 of PS EOW Cell, Naraina for offences under Section 420/120B IPC.
Learned APP accepts notice and seeks and is allowed two weeks to file status report.
It is informed by both sides that the proceedings against the accused/applicant under Section 82 CrPC are under challenge before the learned trial court.

Learned senior counsel for the accused/applicant seeks protection from arrest till the next date on the ground that in the bail application of the co-accused, the prosecution alleged that it is the co-accused who was the This is a digitally signed order.

On the other hand, the learned counsel for complainant de facto submits that despite having been granted interim protection by the trial court, the said co-accused did not join the investigation repeatedly.

In any case, in view of the nature of allegations against the accused/applicant coupled with the pendency of the proceedings challenging the order under Section 82 CrPC, without looking into the status report, I am not inclined to grant any protection at this stage.
